text_block_list.text:
"To offer horse girls even greater 
possibilities." With that wish in mind, 
the academy planned an overseas study 
trip.

Conducted with applicants who volunteered, 
many trainers and horse girls 
participated――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I had heard overseas turf was long, but... 
I see, this really is difficult to run 
on...
choice_data_list:
(As expected, Japanese horse girls find it 
bewildering...)

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, it really is so fluffy! It's totally 
different from Japan~. Which means, which 
means...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
We get to experience whole new thrills in 
races that we can't have in Japan! Kyaa~♡
choice_data_list: !...You can certainly look at it that way.
!...You can certainly look at it that way.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? It should be... around here, but...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Even if I ask, they won't understand 
me. And even if they answer, I won't know 
what they're saying...

Language, an indispensable tool for 
communication. If an accident were to 
occur, it could lead to even greater――

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Bonjour, monsieur! Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I'd like this sandwich, but~... Um, what 
do you call it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Monsieur! This, this one... Nom nom~~! 
C'est bon!

text_block_list.name: French Gentleman
text_block_list.text: Cassecroûte?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cassecroûte? Ooh, so that's what it's 
called! Then, one cassecroûte...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: S'il vous plaît♡

text_block_list.name: French Gentleman
text_block_list.text: Merci!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Merci~~♪ Ehehe, I bought it, I bought it~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...What am I doing... When Vivlos is 
trying so hard...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
B-Bonjour, madame! Um... that is... I-I 
would like to go here!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It seems the tension has melted away. All 
from watching Vivlos-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That lightness of hers has the power to 
make people look forward, after all.
choice_data_list: A power to make people look forward?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes... indeed. She is quite good at it. 
Even before this――

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos-san, has your class already decided 
what you will be doing?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Perfect☆ I can't wait for the Holy 
Hoof Festival attraction~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is impressive. We have only just come 
up with candidate ideas over on our end. 
...Just how did your discussion go?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Eh, just like totally normal☆

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Like, just putting on an attraction is 
super fun already, right? I got all hyped 
up and just kept tossing out whatever came 
to mind~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
And then, everyone who was quiet at first 
started chiming in with so many ideas too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Everyone became that proactive?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup! And we were like 'that sounds great, 
this sounds great!', and it all got 
decided super smoothly~♪

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I do not know whether she is aware of 
it herself.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she makes others want to take 
action. She possesses such a power.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Mess-chan-senpa~i! There's a super 
cute shop over there! Let's go~!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I believe I asked you to refrain from 
that nickname.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Aw, but it's so cuuute~♪ Come on, let's 
go, let's go! Over there, you see――
